title: Localized tensor cohomology comparison inheritance
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings, with R-algebras A and B and an algebra structure on C over T=A\otimes_R B. Assume C is flat over T. Let U,Q be K-flat cochain complexes of A-modules (tensoring any acyclic A-complex with either is acyclic), let N be a cochain complex of C-modules, and let F be termwise scalar extension along A\to T\to C. Given t:F(Q)\to N and base-derived tensor cohomology models [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] m for Q and m_U for U\otimes_A Q, suppose m.localizedComparison followed by H^i(t) is an isomorphism for every i. Then the analogous comparison for U\otimes_A Q, followed by H^i(F(U\otimes Q)\cong F(U)\otimes F(Q)\to F(U)\otimes N), is an isomorphism for every i. The tensor comparison is the inverse scalar-extension tensorator.

proof.text: Use the mixed-ring K-flat tensor associator to rebracket U tensor_A Q tensor_R B, naturally in U and Q, with the commuting B-action. This identifies the canonical comparison for the tensor complex with tensoring the comparison for Q.

Since C is T-flat, extension to C commutes with cohomology and is exact. The model counit equations identify the localized comparison with this scalar extension of the canonical mixed-ring comparison.

For fixed Q,t, the U for which all comparisons are isomorphisms form a localizing subcategory: shifts reindex; sums commute with cohomology and tensor; the five lemma for the long exact cohomology sequences gives triangles; retracts preserve isomorphisms. It contains every shift of A by the assumed comparison for Q. Apply module-derived free generation. K-flatness lets the displayed total tensors compute the derived ones.

theorem localizedTensorComparison_inheritance
    (R A B C : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) C]
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (U Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} C) ℤ)
    (hU : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V U (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} R)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} B)
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    ∀ (t : F.obj Q ⟶ N)
      (m : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B Q C)
      (mU : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B (U ⊗ Q) C),
      (∀ i : ℤ, IsIso (m.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap t i)) →
      ∀ i : ℤ, IsIso (mU.localizedComparison i ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso F U Q).inv ≫ (F.obj U ◁ t)) i)
